sections.label: Effect
sections.text: A time raider acting this turn activates a gravity well in the area. The gravity well sits at the center of the cube and lasts until the end of the encounter, or until a creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the well uses a maneuver to deactivate it. The area is [difficult terrain](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/difficult-terrain) for enemies. Any enemy who ends their turn in the area is [pulled](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) up to 4 squares toward the well.

features.body: Until the end of the round, each time raider gains a +3 bonus to speed, and can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to their speed as a move action.
features.name: Recall Module

features.intro: All time raiders in the encounter collectively create a psionic field over the encounter map, which lasts until the first time raider with the highest [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) maximum drops to 0 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) or chooses to end the field (no action required). While the field is up, each non-time raider on the map makes a **Reason test** against this psionic effect at the start of each round.
features.name: Psi-Cage

flavor: At the start of any time raider's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: Time Raider Malice
